rules.cwe_name: Security Issue (CWE-730)
rules.description: User input should not be used in regular expressions without first being escaped, otherwise a malicious user may be able to inject an expression that could require exponential time on certain inputs.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
rules.description: Building a NoSQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious NoSQL code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
rules.description: Building a SQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious SQL code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File
rules.description: From user-controlled data saved in CSV files, it is easy to attempt information disclosure or other malicious activities when automated by spreadsheet software

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Behavior Order: Early Validation
rules.description: A Unicode transformation is using a remote user-controlled data. The transformation is a Unicode normalization using the algorithms "NFC" or "NFKC". In all cases, the security measures implemented or the logical validation performed to escape any injection characters, to validate using regex pattern

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')
rules.description: Building a XPath query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious Xpath code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Initialization
rules.description: Omitting a comma between strings causes implicit concatenation which is confusing in a list.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
rules.description: Building an LDAP query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious LDAP code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data to create a template can lead to remote code execution or cross site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.
